end.summary:
- Discussed objects that roll or slide.
- Identified a ball and marble as rolling objects.
- Compared a book and matchbox as flat objects that can slide.
- Anika revised their idea about a tea tin: its side is round, so it may roll when lying down.
- Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Anika practised noticing whether an object is round or flat to decide if it may roll or slide. They used their book-on-a-slope experience and later revisited the tea tin, correcting the mix-up by noticing its round side. At home, try gently placing a bottle, tin, book and ball on a slight slope and ask what each one might do.
